text: Toronto Parking Authority entered into an Agreement of Purchase and Sale with Lanterra Developments (Bay Wellesley) Limited (referred to as the Vendor) for the acquisition of a municipal parking facility containing 134 parking spaces at 9 Wellesley Street West (the Property, Car Park 304). The transaction involves the acquisition by the City of a stratified interest in a below-grade portion of the Property within which a municipal parking facility is to be located and form part of a mixed commercial/retail/residential development. Construction of the development, including the municipal parking facility, is completed and the parking facility was turned over to Toronto Parking Authority on May 6, 2021.
